bug_description:
## 🐛 Bug



I just upgraded to PyTorch 1.7 and I now get an this error when multiplying a Python bool with a cuda bool tensor. I do not get the error on CPU. Furthermore, it was working well on the previous version (1.6).

trigger_conditions.condition: Applying element-wise operators with unsupported combinations of tensor dtype and scalar dtype, such as multiplying CUDA boolean tensors with Python boolean scalars.
trigger_conditions.operation_context: Multiply a CUDA boolean tensor by a Python bool scalar using '*' or torch.mul.

failure_behavior.description: Multiply a CUDA boolean tensor by a Python bool scalar using '*' or torch.mul.
